products.title: EliteBook 840 G11 14" Notebook
products.description: The HP EliteBook 840 G11 is a refurbished 14-inch professional notebook designed for high-productivity teams. It is powered by an Intel Core Ultra 7 165U 12-core processor with an integrated NPU for AI-enhanced performance. The laptop features a 1920 x 1200 WUXGA anti-glare IPS display with 1000 nits of brightness, 100% sRGB coverage, and an integrated HP Sure View privacy panel. It comes equipped with 32GB of DDR5 RAM (expandable to 64GB), a 512GB PCIe NVMe SSD, and runs on Windows 11 Pro. Connectivity options include two Thunderbolt 4 ports, two USB-A 3.2 Gen 1 ports, HDMI 2.1, Wi-Fi 6E, and Bluetooth 5.3. Additional features include a 5MP IR webcam for facial authentication, a fingerprint reader, and a backlit keyboard.
